# A document that calls an accepted record a draft

This file is deliberately broken.

The footnote below names a record in the accepted directory and calls it a
draft.[^1] The registry holds the status of a record, and no other place does.
The check must fail on it.

## References

[^1]: ADR-0001, one binary gives one answer at any thread count, decision D1, a draft record. `docs/adrs/accepted/adr-0001-one-binary-gives-one-answer-at-any-thread-count.md`
